# Warning and error codes

<!-- Generated by `npm run codes` from the codes the source emits. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every code the CLI and the build emit, with the first sentence of the message it comes with.
Match on the code, never on the message text: messages are reworded, codes are not.

## Error codes

`error.code` of a failure document (`--json`, or any piped run): `{ ok: false, error: { code, message, exitCode, details? } }`.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SDK_BRANCH_LIVE` | The branch is the live one and cannot be deleted or replaced that way. Exit 2. |
| `SDK_BRANCH_TAKEN` | The branch label is already in use. Exit 2. |
| `SDK_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION` | The workspace's rows break a unique index, required column or reference the release declares; nothing landed (`details.constraint`). Exit 2. |
| `SDK_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED` | The instance rejected the credential (`details`: `{ profile, credentialType, instance, workspaceId, signIn }`). |
| `SDK_DRIFT` | A committed artifact (`xano.lock`, `.env.example`, `routes.gen.ts`) is out of date with the source — `--check`, `--strict`, `--frozen-lock`. |
| `SDK_ERROR` | Any failure without a code of its own; `exitCode` says which kind. |
| `SDK_EXPORT_INVALID` | The workspace does not build: `details.diagnostics[]` lists every error (and, under `--strict`, every warning). |
| `SDK_IDENTITY_CONFLICT` | A landing would delete or re-create an object under another identity; nothing was written (`details.refused`). Exit 2. |
| `SDK_IMPORT_REFUSED` | The target refused the import (`details.refused` names the check); exit 8 when another import was running. |
| `SDK_KIND_CONFLICT` | A name the target holds as another kind of object; nothing was written. Exit 2. |
| `SDK_LIVE_BRANCH_MISMATCH` | The live branch is not the one the command expected (`details.conflictsWith`). |
| `SDK_PRUNE_OUT_OF_SCOPE` | A landing would delete objects another source landed (`details.refused: "pruneOutOfScope"`). Exit 2. |
| `SDK_RELEASE_FILES_NOT_CARRIED` | The release cannot carry the files (hosted files, static assets) the source needs. |
| `SDK_RELEASE_NAME_TAKEN` | A release with that name already exists. Exit 2. |
| `SDK_SEED_IN_STATIC` | A static build carries seed values from non-public columns (`details.leaks[]`); nothing was published. |
| `SDK_SHARED_SCHEMA_CHANGE` | A promote would alter tables live serves from (`details.reason: "shared-schema-changes"`, `details.changes[]`), or could not read them (`"tables-unreadable"`); `--allow-shared-schema-changes` lands it. Exit 2. |
| `SDK_USAGE` | The input is wrong — a command line, a def or a value the build or the command refuses as written — a confirmation was needed off a terminal (`details.reason: "needs-confirmation"`), or the named backend is in another workspace (`details.reason: "wrong-workspace"`, `details.heldIn`). Exit 1. |
